method.github: gh api (authenticated): repos/{o}/{r}, /languages, /commits?sha=X&per_page=1 (commit count = last page in Link header), /contributors?per_page=1&anon=true (count incl. unlinked emails) and per_page=100 (GitHub accounts), /releases, /branches, search/issues (open issues vs PRs); raw responses in oss/api/.
method.clones: git clone --depth 1 --single-branch --branch <pinned branch> over HTTPS into oss/src/; Wemake's pinned commit was additionally fetched at depth 1 (oss/src/gimhol__Little-Fighter-Wemake@pinned) because main moved on. Clones were not modified.
method.loc: cloc 'code' lines (non-blank, non-comment) of programming languages only; excluded: vendored libraries, docs, data/assets, build output, legacy dirs, IDE files; tests counted separately. Neora MASM recounted by hand (cloc misclassifies .inc). Rules in oss/loc_rules.py, results in oss/loc_classified.json.
method.matrix: Values yes/partial/no/unknown decided by reading README and the cited source lines at the pinned commit (Wemake current-head facts cite commit f7487c4). 'partial' means only part of the capability exists or it exists in a non-LF2 form.
